Which statement about the structure of an atom is correct?
A
Electrons and protons each have a relative mass of 1, and neutrons have no charge.
B
Electrons have a relative mass of 1 and a negative charge.
C
Protons have a relative mass of 1 and a negative charge.
D
Neutrons have a relative mass of 1 and no charge.

options.label: A
options.text: Electrons and protons each have a relative mass of 1, and neutrons have no charge.

options.label: B
options.text: Electrons have a relative mass of 1 and a negative charge.
